evidence_refs.description: Dated photo series of one street with bins left out.
evidence_refs.supports: Bins stay out for several days after the pickup day.

fields.existing_efforts: The waste services office publishes a quarterly service log, which is the source of the skipped-round count.

options: Ask the waste services office for the reason codes of skipped rounds.
Ask for a published schedule of replacement rounds.

fields.affected: Residents of Riverside Ward, especially older people and families with small children; the number of households is not known.

observed_facts.statement: The published collection calendar lists weekly pickup for the ward, and the service log shows 19 skipped rounds in the spring quarter.
I counted bins left out past the pickup day on my own street during four weeks.

uncertain_claims.statement: Skipped rounds may come from a driver shortage rather than a route change.
uncertain_claims.why_uncertain: The service log gives counts but no reason for each skipped round.
uncertain_claims.what_would_settle_it: The reason codes kept by the waste services office for each skipped round.

sources.establishes: The count of skipped collection rounds in the ward for the spring quarter.
The promised weekly pickup day for each street in the ward.

causal_hypothesis.statement: A shortage of drivers may explain the skipped rounds, but the service log does not say so (hypothesis, not tested).

fields.scope: Household waste collection in Riverside Ward since February this year; not recycling points and not other wards.
fields.desired_outcome: Every street in Riverside Ward is collected on its published day and anyone can read the skipped-round count each month.

final_acceptance_criteria.statement: Fewer than 2 skipped rounds per quarter in the ward.
final_acceptance_criteria.how_observed: The public service log, read at the end of the quarter.

final_acceptance_criteria.statement: Skipped rounds each carry a published reason code.
final_acceptance_criteria.how_observed: A sample of 10 skipped rounds in the public log, each with a reason.

assumptions.statement: The service log records every skipped round.
assumptions.how_to_check: Compare the log with the street photo dates for the same weeks.

assumptions.statement: The Head of Waste Services is the office that can change the routes.
assumptions.how_to_check: Read the topic table for waste collection in the public service rules.

stage_plan.name: map_skipped
stage_plan.label: Map the skipped rounds
stage_plan.goal: List every street and date with a skipped round.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every skipped round in the quarter is listed by street and date.
acceptance_criteria.measure: A public list checked against the service log.

stage_plan.name: ask_reasons
stage_plan.label: Ask for reason codes
stage_plan.goal: Get the reason codes for skipped rounds from the waste services office.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The office gives a reason for each skipped round.
acceptance_criteria.measure: The reply is posted publicly with the codes.

stage_plan.name: agree_fix
stage_plan.label: Agree a fix
stage_plan.goal: Choose one lawful fix for the skipped rounds.

acceptance_criteria.statement: One fix is chosen and written down.
acceptance_criteria.measure: The decision record names the fix and who does it.

fields.uncertainty: I do not know who owns it today.
